root_cause.text: The `nr_output()` function in the NETROM subsystem returns early without freeing the input `sk_buff` when `sock_alloc_send_skb()` fails to allocate a new socket buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `net/netrom/nr_out.c` shows that when `sock_alloc_send_skb()` returns `NULL`, `kfree_skb(skb)` is added to free the original socket buffer before returning from `nr_output()`.

intent_record.what: Added a call to kfree_skb(skb) inside the error path when sock_alloc_send_skb returns NULL.
intent_record.how: Prevents a memory leak of the original socket buffer (skb) when allocation of a new buffer fails during transmission.
